record.edic_text:
1286 diaseio {dee-as-i'-o}

from 1223 and 4579;; v

AV - do violence to 1; 1

1) to shake thoroughly
2) to make to tremble
3) to terrify
4) to agitate
5) to extort from one by intimidation money or other property

same.cexp: 搖動，吹落；（城市）騷動；顫抖
